description: A Python script to run multinode training with submitit, including argument parsing, shared folder setup, checkpoint handling, and job submission for distributed training.

classes.name: Trainer
classes.description: Handles training setup, checkpointing, and GPU environment configuration for distributed training.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, extending detection's argument parser with additional options.

methods.name: get_shared_folder
methods.description: Returns a shared folder Path object, creating it if necessary, based on environment variables.

methods.name: get_init_file
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique init file path for distributed training initialization.

methods.name: Trainer.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Trainer with command-line arguments.

methods.name: Trainer.__call__
methods.description: Runs the detection main function after setting up GPU arguments.

methods.name: Trainer.checkpoint
methods.description: Prepares a checkpoint for requeuing the training job.

methods.name: Trainer._setup_gpu_args
methods.description: Configures GPU-related arguments based on the current job environment.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up the job executor, configures parameters, and submits the training job.
